name: VelocityMarquee
description: Two counter-direction marquee rows pinned inside a smooth-scroll viewport: they drift at a base speed, then accelerate, flip direction and skew with scroll velocity, easing back smoothly when scrolling stops.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" with an aria-label, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) and see a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the top/bottom edge wheel events are released so the page keeps scrolling. Touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Under prefers-reduced-motion (or smooth=false) the wheel is not intercepted at all. The marquee rows are aria-hidden duplicates; the phrases are exposed once via the region's aria-label. The loop pauses off-screen (IntersectionObserver) and does not run at all under prefers-reduced-motion.

propsApi.name: text
propsApi.description: Phrases repeated along both marquee rows.

propsApi.name: baseSpeed
propsApi.description: Idle drift speed in px per 60fps frame.

propsApi.name: velocityFactor
propsApi.description: How strongly scroll velocity boosts the marquee speed.

propsApi.name: skew
propsApi.description: Skew the rows in proportion to scroll velocity.

propsApi.name: outline
propsApi.description: Render the second row as outlined text.

propsApi.name: fontSize
propsApi.description: Font size in px; shrinks on narrow containers.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
